paite: Chik lai peuh in leng TOUPA ka phat ding a; amah phatna ka kam ah apawt gige ding hi.
heading: Abimelek Ma A Kihaisak A, Ama'n Asawlkhiak A, Apaikhiak Lai A. David La / Pathian Hoihna Phatna

paite: Ka hinna in TOUPA asuang ding a, thunuailutte'n huai aza ding ua, akipak ding uhi.
Aw, TOUPA hon phatpih unla, amin pahtawi chiat ni.
TOUPA ka zong a ama'n ahon dawng a, ka kihtak peuhmah lak ah ahon humbit hi.
Amah a-en ua, huchi in ahong vakta uhi; amelte uh chik mah in azum kei ding.
Hiai migenthei akikou a, TOUPA'N aza a, amangbatna tengteng ah ahunkheta hi.
Amah laudan siamte tuh akimvel uah TOUPA angel in a-opkhum a, ahumbit hi.
Aw, TOUPA hoihdan chiam him dih ua; amah a muanna koihmi ahampha hi.
Amisiangthoute aw, TOUPA laudan siam un; amah laudan siamte a ding in taksapna himhim a-om louh ziak in.
Humpinelkai lunlaite tuh atasam un agilkial naknak uh; TOUPA zongte zaw thil hoih himhim atasam kei ding uhi.
Kisa un, naupangte, ka thu ngaikhia un; TOUPA laudan ka hon hilh ding hi.
Hoihna amuhtheihna ding un, hinna deih a damsawt utmi kua ahia?
Na lei tuh gilou lak ah venghoih inla, na muk khemna thu gen lou ding in venghoih in.
Gilou paisan inla, thil hoih hih in; lemna zong inla, adelh in delh in.
TOUPA mit in midiktatte a-en gige a, abil in asap uh za ding in angaikhe gige hi.
TOUPA mel in thil hihkhialte adou a, amau theihgigena lei a kipan hihmangthang ding in.
Midiktatte akikou ua, TOUPA'N aza a, amangbatna tengteng uah ahunkheta hi.
TOUPA'N lungtang khasiate anaih zel a, lungsim a kisik peuhmahte ahondam zel hi.
Midik haksatnate atam a, himahleh TOUPA'N huaite a pan ahonkhia ahi.
Aguh tengteng akemhoih a, khat lel leng hihtan ahi kei hi.
Thil hoih lou in migilou-saloute athat ding a; dik hote'n siam louh atang ding uhi.
TOUPA'N asikhate hinna atan a; amah a muanna koihte khat lel leng siam louh tang a-om kei ding uhi.
